evals.prompt: make an Instagram carousel about 5 pricing-page mistakes SaaS founders make
evals.expected_output: A slide-by-slide script: a hook cover, one-idea content slides, a recap slide, and a CTA slide — each with copy, a design note, and an image-generation prompt.
assertions: Each content slide carries a single idea
Ends with a recap slide and a CTA slide
Every slide has an image-generation prompt a designer or model could run

evals.prompt: turn this into a LinkedIn document post: our team cut meeting time 40% by killing standups
evals.expected_output: A LinkedIn document-post carousel adapted to LinkedIn's cover and density conventions, one idea per slide, with design notes and image prompts.
assertions: Slides follow LinkedIn document-post conventions, not Instagram's
Cover slide states a clear hook
